preserve: exact test call to visible product function
actual argument zero to formal parameter zero
test guard to each guarded assertion
product normal continuation from aborter call to fallback
product exceptional exits to the pytest capture and both membership assertions
overwrite, early-return, catch, finally, and cross-process value mechanisms
exclude: lexical nesting or source order as dependency evidence
same variable name as cross-scope binding evidence
visible pure call as an opaque side-effect or exception boundary
exceptions handled inside the callee or with body
unknown: dynamic calls outside the registered support domain

semantic_scope: bounded may-influence for the registered Flask observations; exact values and path satisfiability remain unknown
